project.title: Launch of Hybrid Retail Investment Corner in Flagship Store
project.objective: Design and launch an in-store "investment corner" that sells retail financial products and related services while integrating logistics and compliance.
deliverables: Defined product and service catalogue for the investment corner
Standardised customer sales and advisory scripts
Store layout and logistics plan for investment corner area
Financial compliance and accounting process documentation
Training session and checklist for store and logistics staff
constraints: All financial product information must comply with regulatory disclosure rules
Store layout changes must not exceed existing floor space allocation
Project must be delivered within the approved budget and 21-day timebox
Customer data handling must follow internal privacy and security policies
Operational disruption to existing store operations must be minimal

risks.risk: Financial product explanations may be too complex for walk-in customers.
risks.mitigation: Create simplified scripts, FAQs, and visual aids validated by stock traders and specialised sellers.

risks.risk: Non-compliant sales practices could expose the company to regulatory penalties.
risks.mitigation: Have accountant and stock traders review scripts and processes with compliance before launch.

risks.risk: Store reconfiguration may disrupt normal sales and deliveries.
risks.mitigation: Mover plans phased layout changes and after-hours moves with a detailed checklist.

risks.risk: Revenue tracking for the investment corner may be inaccurate at launch.
risks.mitigation: Accountant defines dedicated accounts, coding rules, and reconciliation procedures before go-live.

themes.why_relevant: Specialised sellers and stock traders must explain complex products in simple, compliant language.
Accountant and traders must ensure all sales, records, and disclosures meet legal standards.
Mover must adapt space and flows so the investment corner fits without disrupting operations.
Retail, trading, logistics, and accounting roles must align on processes and timelines.
Stock traders and accountant need clear data to monitor product uptake and profitability.

backlog.task: Define the initial catalogue of retail investment products and related services for the corner
definition_of_done: List of products and services is documented and shared
Risk level and target customer segment defined for each product
Compliance officer has signed off on the catalogue

backlog.task: Draft customer-facing sales and advisory scripts for the investment corner
definition_of_done: Scripts cover greeting, discovery, explanation, and closing
Stock trader reviews technical accuracy of product explanations
Accountant confirms scripts do not promise guaranteed returns

backlog.task: Create simplified product information sheets and visual aids
definition_of_done: One-page sheet created for each product in the catalogue
Risk warnings and disclaimers included on each sheet
Specialised sellers confirm materials are understandable for customers

backlog.task: Design the physical layout and furniture plan for the investment corner
definition_of_done: Layout sketch shows furniture, displays, and customer flow
Plan respects existing safety and accessibility rules
Retail operations manager approves the layout

backlog.task: Define accounting treatment and reporting structure for investment corner sales
definition_of_done: Chart of accounts updated with dedicated codes
Monthly reporting template created
Reconciliation process documented and shared with finance

backlog.task: Document end-to-end sales and follow-up process for investment corner customers
definition_of_done: Process map covers pre-sale, sale, and post-sale follow-up
Handoffs between store staff and stock traders are defined
Customer data handling steps comply with privacy policy

backlog.task: Set up a simple tracking sheet for daily sales, leads, and customer questions
definition_of_done: Sheet structure agreed with stock traders and specialised sellers
Fields for product, amount, customer type, and follow-up added
Test entries validated against accounting rules

backlog.task: Plan and schedule the physical move and installation of the investment corner
definition_of_done: Move schedule created with minimal disruption windows
Required equipment and manpower listed
Store operations confirms schedule is acceptable

backlog.task: Run a joint training session for store staff on products, scripts, and processes
definition_of_done: Agenda and materials prepared and shared in advance
Specialised sellers and mover attend or review recording
Key questions and clarifications captured for follow-up

backlog.task: Create a daily operational checklist for the investment corner
definition_of_done: Checklist covers opening, mid-day checks, and closing
Includes stock of brochures and visibility of risk warnings
Mover and accountant confirm logistics and cash-handling steps

backlog.task: Define escalation rules for complex customer financial questions
definition_of_done: Criteria for escalation from store staff to traders documented
Response time expectations agreed
Contact channels and availability windows listed

backlog.task: Prepare a short launch performance review template for week 1
definition_of_done: Template includes sales, leads, and key issues
Stock traders and specialised sellers can add qualitative feedback
Agreed to be used in first post-launch review

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, product catalogue, and success criteria for the investment corner.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and asking for confirmation of scope and product list.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the initial list of products and services in A1 for launch.
Agree on top three success metrics to track in A3 during the first month.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize customer scripts, education materials, and escalation rules.
threads_plan.trigger: Specialised seller shares draft scripts and asks for feedback from traders and accountant.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the final version of the customer sales and advisory script in A2.
Confirm the escalation criteria and channels defined in A7.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on layout, logistics plan, and move schedule for the investment corner.
threads_plan.trigger: Mover posts the proposed layout and move plan for review by the team.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final layout and logistics plan in A6.
Confirm the move and installation schedule from T8.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock down accounting, tracking, and reporting processes before launch.
threads_plan.trigger: Accountant shares draft accounting and reporting process for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the accounting and compliance process described in A5.
Agree on the final structure of the daily tracker A3 and week 1 review template A8.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate training, go-live checklist, and launch day responsibilities.
threads_plan.trigger: Stock trader proposes training date and specialised seller shares draft daily checklist.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm training session date, format, and required attendees from T9.
Approve the daily operations checklist in A4 for launch use.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each role posts yesterday's progress, today's plan, and blockers.
Twice-weekly planning huddle thread to review backlog tasks and adjust priorities.
Pre-launch readiness checklist review one day before go-live to confirm all items in A4 are covered.
End-of-week mini-retrospective using A8 to capture learnings and improvement ideas.
Post-training Q&A thread where staff can ask follow-up questions on scripts and processes.
